remarks: Welcome to 653 Center street in the heart of Cherry Creek. This 2330sqft well maintained four bedroom two and a half bath home is full of updates in form and function including a commanding first floor kitchen and half bath renovation with it's own heating zone. This move-in ready home has new windows throughout both floors, a 200AMP circuit breaker box and updated wiring for the entire house, and all appliances are included. Tankless water heater (2022) provides endless supply of hot water for the house and garage! NEST wifi thermostat system, wood-fired boiler, and multi-zone heat distribution maximizes comfort and efficiency during the cold months. Large unfinished room to the rear of the home, closets in every room, and a second floor open attic space in the barn provide ample storage year round. The barn features 2 car bays, concrete floor with newly installed insulated garage doors and work shop space. There is a separate space to the rear of the barn for wood storage. Covered 6' x 19' porch on front entrance as well as an 11' x 29' deck gives plenty of useful space outside the home. Municipal water and private septic. Other notable features are 8ft ceilings throughout the home, recessed lighting on first floor, and a recently poured basement floor (2022). Book a showing at your earliest convenience.
